title: Naturality of evaluation homology comparison
statement: Naturality of sourceClassDerivedHomIso, leftHomologyData and sourceFreeSectionsComplexIso under restriction.

proof.text: Construct precomposition on the Hom complex by composing with the degree-zero cochain of the source map. The differential formula δ_ofHom_comp shows that it restricts to cocycles and descends to cohomology classes, carrying boundaries to boundaries.

Use ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData with these explicit cocycle and class maps to identify the induced homology map. On a cocycle representative, equivHomShift_symm_precomp and naturality of quotientCompQhIso and singleFunctorIsoCompQ prove compatibility with sourceClassDerivedHomIso; surjectivity of the class projection extends the equality to every class.

On cochains from a single complex, fromSingleMk_precomp and naturality of strictLocalFreeSheafSections identify precomposition with restriction of sections. Apply the homology functor to this degreewise square, cancel the derived-class isomorphism, and paste the class, homology, and evaluation squares.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q8 and 03Q9; explicit naturality of the fixed comparison maps

lean.statement:
theorem sourceDerivedSections_naturality_evaluation
    {C : Type (v + 1)} [Category.{v} C]
    {T : GrothendieckTopology C} [HasSheafify T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (Sheaf T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})]
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (L : CochainComplex (Sheaf T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ) [L.IsKInjective]
    (q : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) (n : ℤ) {U V : C} (a : U ⟶ V) :
    let H := HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (.up ℤ) n
    let e₁ := fun W : C ↦
      (sourceClassDerivedHomIso ((strictLocalFreeSheaf T).obj W) L n).symm ≪≫
      (leftHomologyData ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((strictLocalFreeSheaf T).obj W)) L n).homologyIso.symm ≪≫
      H.mapIso (sourceFreeSectionsComplexIso W L)
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Preadditive.leftComp ((DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)⟦n⟧)
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map ((strictLocalFreeSheaf T).map a))) ≫
        (e₁ U).hom =
      (e₁ V).hom ≫ H.map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
          ((sheafSections T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map a.op) (.up ℤ)).app L)
